terms.grammar: in with the accusative, and the person in the genitive
evidence: Traupman 103: in memory of, in memoriam (+ gen.)
terms.comment: The formula of dedications and gravestones. Lewis & Short quotes in memoriam only in the sense “into the memory” (in memoriam redīre, to come back to mind; in memoriam redigere, to recall), not as “in memory of someone”; so it is given here as modern, on Traupman’s authority.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 103, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
